sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Water Release, Lightning Release, Reezaa Branch

system.description:
You Fire bolts of storm Chakra at each creature within a 15-foot radius centered on you. This radius extends around corners, and you do not need to see the creatures to affect them. When you cast this jutsu, you can designate any number of creatures to be unaffected by this jutsu. The remaining creatures in range creatures take 3d6 Lightning damage and must make a Constitution saving throw, being marked as a Refraction Point for the next minute on a failed save.

Additionally, creatures already marked as a Refraction Point extend its duration by 1 round, and suffer a 1d4 penalty on their next saving throw.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the radius by 5 feet. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the damage of this jutsu by 2d6.
